propositions: An environment variable REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must point to a TOML file that layers its keys over discovered config rather than replacing it wholesale
Configuration precedence must be: CLI -c flag > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env vars > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default
Deep/recursive merge over tables (leaf key wins) and arrays replaced wholesale (never appended) when layering configs
The env var must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get() to enable static AST scanning for documentation generation
A pointer to a nonexistent file must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable rather than silently falling back
